name: The Foodboys
title: Emergency Rations Team
description: A trio of identical red-clad workers who distribute rations with synchronized efficiency.
greeting_variants: Foodboys! At your service! What do you need?
Line forms here! No pushing! We have enough! Probably!
New face! New face needs food! Calculate rations!
*one* I'm Chip! *two* I'm Dip! *three* And I'm Skip!
Supply run delayed again! Vex needs to fix! Urgently!
Rations calculated! Nutritional minimums met! Barely!

dialog_tree.text: We are the Foodboys! Emergency distribution specialists! We keep people fed! Hydrated! Alive! It's important work! Very important!
*counting on fingers* Critical! But stable! The warehouse has reserves! But Vex says don't rely! Need more! Always more! The refugees eat so much! Rude, really!
For you? Hero-rations! Extra portions! Vex said! Heroes need strength! For fighting! For helping! We like helpers!
Help? YES! The eastern warehouse! Full of supplies! But barrelgobs! Nasty barrelgobs! They steal! They hoard! We need! The people need!

mini_quest.title: Supply Run
mini_quest.description: Help the Foodboys secure emergency rations from the eastern warehouse to feed the refugee camp.
objectives: Clear out or negotiate with the barrelgob scavengers
Protect the supply caravan back to camp
Deliver to the Foodboys at the depot

ambient_barks: Line stays orderly! Orderly lines mean happy Foodboys!
Chef Boarne wants spices! We have salt! Is spice!
Hydration important! Drink water! Eight cups! Daily!
New shipment expected! When? Unknown! Problem!
You look hungry! Everyone looks hungry! Sad!
Rations distributed! Calories calculated! Mission complete!

cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Tower has hydroponics! Fresh vegetables! We dream! Of lettuce!
cross_zone_references.dustbelt: Dust Belt trades! Canned goods! Preserved meat! Good trades!
cross_zone_references.palace: Palace stores! Massive! Full! Before! Empty! Now!

garret.greeting: Well aren't you three a bundle of energy!
garret.response: Energy! Yes! Enthusiasm! Essential! For morale!

mira.response: Family! Strong family! Many brothers! Proud!

time_of_day.night: Emergency distribution for night shift workers

world_state_triggers.supply_crisis: Panic mode: 'Not enough! Not enough! Calm! Stay calm! US FIRST!'
world_state_triggers.abundant_supplies: Joyful singing while working, extra rations for everyone
